# SciTeX Family

## scitex.ai
https://github.com/scitex-cloud

## All-in-one Python package
https://github.com/scitex-python

## Downstream, standalone packages
https://github.com/scitex-writer
https://github.com/figrecipe
https://github.com/crossref-local
https://github.com/socialia

## Rules

### All
- MCP servers must be implemented via fastmcp

### scitex-cloud should:
- Use scitex-python
- Not have custom logic as much as possible
- Use SCITEX_CLOUD_ prefix for env vars

### scitex-python should:
- Use downstream packages
- Not have custom logic but programatically use downstream packages as is
- Handle branding
- Use SCITEX_PYTHON_ prefix for env vars

### Downstream packages should:
- Be fully standalone
- Python APIs -> CLI commands -> MCP tools
  - MCP calls must be reproduced by corresponding Python API or CLI commands
- Have branding switcher
- Use SCITEX_PYTHON_ prefix for env vars

## Consistency: SciTeX Packages should:
- Be licensed via AGPL-3.0
- Have standardized convensions
  - Python APIs (exposed/internal
  - File/function/class names
  - CLI commands
  - MCP tools
- README.md should have similar formats

## Useful Tools
### scitex.writer delegation (should be exactly same)
scitex introspect api scitex-writer
scitex introspect api scitex.writer

### scitex.plt delegation
scitex introspect api scitex-figrecipe
scitex introspect api scitex.plt

### scitex.scholar delegation (should be exactly same)
scitex introspect api crossref-local
scitex introspect api scitex.scholar

### scitex.social delegation (should be exactly same)
scitex introspect api socialia
scitex introspect api scitex.social
